assessment_map.source_rule: Pre-fill: member; verify where sources conflict
Pre-fill: pharmacy + CCD + med history; verify on call
Pre-fill if in labs/CCD ≤30 days; else ask

rules.priority: Urgency (0–50: nearest OPEN clinical window ≤24 h = 50, ≤72 h = 35, ≤7 d = 20, ≤30 d = 10; administrative and informational gaps excluded; open_window flag from the gap row) + Acuity (0–35: tier High 15 / Moderate 10 / Rising 10 / Low 5, ADT ≤7 d +10, urgent live event ≤7 d +10) + Signals (0–15: +8 per high, +4 per medium). A clinical window ≤24 h is a hard override into Today. Verification items (conflicts) are NOT in priority.
rules.bucket: Today (deadline) = any clinical window ≤24 h, never bumped · Today = score ≥60 within the day's remaining member slots (18 attempt slots ÷ 2 attempts per member = 9) · Tomorrow = score ≥65 bumped by capacity · This week = the rest. Overflow: deadline members beyond the slots get 1 attempt today and an escalation banner.
rules.confidence: Coverage × freshness: +25 PBM extract current (visible rows) · +15 ADT subscription · +15 clinical document (+8 partial) · +10 mapped lab ≤90 d · +15 a contact reached ≤90 d · +10 own HRA ≤12 mo · +5 consent status known · +5 no open identity question. ≥75 complete · 50–74 adequate · <50 'sparse picture — verify by conversation'. Finding a conflict never lowers confidence; conflicts are 'verify on the call' items, resolved after Reached.
rules.reachability: Per number: +10 active-record cell / +5 other active field / +2 termed-record field · +40 reached ≤90 d (+20 older; +10 if member could not confirm meds) · +30 member called from it (call-centre ANI) · +10 per ADT PID appearance · +25 listed other contact (address source) · −50 not in service · −3 per no-answer. Window: HRA best time > caregiver works full time (clinical extract) → evening team > hour of last effective success. Channel: call first whenever an open clinical window closes within 4 h; otherwise text only with SMS consent on file AND a number the member gave the plan; harvested numbers are call-only.
rules.identity: Linked record = same DOB + ≥2 name tokens + shared facility MRN or phone; masked until confirmed. Items that exist only because a linked record was read are marked pending_link. Dependent-suffix claims (<id>-<suffix>) with Z38/P59/Z00.11x on an adult female record = newborn encounters, excluded from her utilisation.
rules.clinical_rule_content: Approved-list rules owned by the plan's P&T / medical director: dispensed-but-STOPPED; DUR override surfaced; ACEi+ARNI; K ≥5.0 with K supplement; K supplement + new MRA without a repeat lab; glucose ≥300; PHQ-9 ≥10 without booked follow-up; duplicate sedative-hypnotics after a fall; severe-range home BP (SBP ≥160 or DBP ≥110); chronic-therapy persistence gap >7 d (GLP-1, MOUD); ED overdose in ADT. Every output is a coordination action (notify, ask, book, route) — never a dosing or hold instruction. Rule parameters (dates, drugs, tiers, names) are read from the rows.
rules.human_in_loop: Every verification item, next-best-action step and pre-filled field is 'AI draft' until the clinician confirms it on the outreach screen after the member is reached; confirmations are logged with user, time and the evidence shown. The 8 am prose line is an authored exemplar; brief_composed is the engine's cited version.
